intent: runtime-split Phase 5a: policy-channel state tracking — Migration 012 machine_policy_states + report/drift endpoints
notes: **Phase 5a of the runtime split — the policy channel's state half, opening the item-19 endgame.** D5 recorded en route: the Phases 1-4 release ships as **2.9.0** (Architect-ratified 2026-08-21). E3's `Policy`/`PolicyVersion` already provide content-addressed policy versioning; 5a adds the missing what-is-in-force-where tracking so "which machines/repos are on which policy version, where is the drift" is ONE query — Enterprise as the query surface, the (5b) repo-side policy pin as the Git proof surface.

**Migration 012 + model `machine_policy_states`**: one CURRENT row per (org, machine, repo_identifier, policy), upserted on report; `repo_identifier NOT NULL DEFAULT ''` for machine-level scope (the Migration 011 NULL-collision lesson applied); `machine_id` plain varchar per the commits precedent; `content_hash` denormalized for join-free drift comparison. Applied to local Postgres — head 012, table verified.

**Routes** (`policy_state.py`): `POST /policy-state/report` (per-entry outcomes — unknown slug / unmatched hash error individually, never batch-500; `in_sync` returned per entry so clients surface drift immediately), `GET /policy-state` (fleet state + filters), `GET /policy-state/drift` (stale + applied-but-retired rows; explicitly REPORT-BASED with the never-reported≠in-sync caveat documented; missing-coverage vs machine_keys is a named follow-on).

**15 new tests** (`test_policy_state.py`, per-file fixtures per house convention) incl. the channel's killer property: `test_activation_change_flips_drift_without_new_reports` — org activates a new policy version and every reported machine flips to drifted instantly, no re-reports.

**Pre-existing latent bug fixed en route**: `PolicyVersion`'s one-active-per-policy partial unique index declared only `postgresql_where` — SQLite create_all ignores it, degrading to a FULL unique on policy_id, so any second version 500'd in the test environment (masked until now: no prior test created two versions). `sqlite_where` added; production Postgres schema unchanged.
Suite: enterprise **330 pass + 1 skip** (315 → 330), zero regressions. Charter: `scripts-enterprise.md` Phase 5a block with the upsert-shape TRIPWIRE.
